description: VYBE MUSIC v4.1.2 — Zero Lag Performance Optimization, Prominent Sleep Timer in Now Playing Menu & Badge, 'Update Now' or 'Later' options, and Cleaned Update Settings.

changelog.title: Zero Lag & Smooth Performance
items: Unlocked full 90Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz high refresh rate hardware modes for ultra-responsive animations and silky scrolling
Optimized Compose GPU rendering by eliminating continuous offscreen backdrop captures when liquid glass is idle
Zero UI latency: buttery-smooth page transitions, drawer navigation, and player sheet expansion

changelog.title: Prominent Sleep Timer
items: Added dedicated Sleep Timer pill button with live countdown directly in the Now Playing menu action grid
Added Sleep Timer as a top-level item in Player Menu with full interactive minutes slider and End of Song mode
Made audio quality/timer badge on player screen directly 1-tap clickable to set or adjust sleep timer

changelog.title: Update System Polish
items: Added 'Update Now' or 'Later' options to Force Update overlay and Admin update dialogs with session deferral
Removed internal test and preview controls from Update Settings for a clean production interface
Admin Portal broadcast update notification button to trigger instant device alerts

changelog.title: Listen Together Real-Time Sync & Beat Sync
items: True local audio synchronization: host play, pause, resume, seek, and track change instantly sync on all connected guests
Beat Sync: automatic micro-playback speed adjustment (1.03x / 0.97x) seamlessly eliminates drift without audio clicks
Restored full Play/Pause controls in Player and Mini Player for guests
Latency-compensated instant join and reconnect playback synchronization
